forum.title: HAL_TIM_IC_ReadChannelCapturedValue returns 0
forum.best_answer_content:
The problem was that I called HAL\_TIM\_IC\_StartChannel\_IT:

```

HAL_TIM_IC_StartChannel_IT(mx_tim2_gethandle(), HAL_TIM_CHANNEL_4)

```

but I did not call:

```

HAL_TIM_Start(mx_tim2_gethandle());

```

The example from [TIM input capture Github](https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/STM32CubeC5/blob/main/examples/hal/tim/input_capture/application/example.c) was very useful.

Sorry for the trouble,

Gil
